_comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for model selection, budgets, and guardrails. Both modes (copilot, agnostic) are GENERATED from this file by tools/generate.mjs. Never edit per-agent models in the generated modes/ folders — edit them here and regenerate, or drift is guaranteed.
_initiative_doc: AOP-001 = Agentic Operations Platform, v0.2 implementation spec in requirements/AOP-001-agentic-operations-platform.md. The generator stamps this into copilot-instructions.md and CLAUDE.md.
_tier_doc: Agents are assigned an ABSTRACT TIER, never a hardcoded model. Each mode resolves the tier to a concrete model via tier_resolution below. Change an agent's tier here and both modes update on regenerate.
_resolution_doc: tier -> concrete model, per mode. agnostic runs on a single provider at runtime (Claude Code = Claude family only), so its tiers stay within one frontier family. copilot can route cross-provider per agent.

agnostic._note: Within the chosen frontier family. Swap the whole family by editing these three lines.

_budget_doc: Hard stops. Supervisor checks remaining budget BEFORE each handoff and tracks consumed against API-reported usage. First ceiling hit halts. BUDGET_ALERT at alert_pct, BUDGET_EXCEEDED on breach.

budgets._override_doc: Engineers may lower (never silently raise) any budget at invocation: /run-pipeline req=AOP-001 --max-story-tokens=150000 --spend-cap=8

_guardrail_doc: Correctness + safety controls enforced by the supervisor regardless of mode.

guardrails._repeat_doc: If the SAME failed_checks recur across self-heal attempts, halt early instead of burning all 3 — addresses the Unreliability Tax.
guardrails._test_doc: Supervisor runs the project test + lint command and gates on the real exit code. Agent self-reported PASS is never sufficient. Both scripts are wired at the repo root (see package.json) and fan out to every workspace via pnpm -r; a fresh checkout passes both with zero stories built yet — see loop/config/README or the root package.json scripts for what each currently runs.
guardrails._iso_doc: Each agent receives only its declared inputs (planning_context, codegen file list) — never the full accumulated transcript. Primary defense against O(n^2) token growth.
guardrails._git_doc: Each story on its own branch; gate rejection or self-heal exhaustion auto-reverts the working tree.

composite_context._doc: The Supervisor generates a stage-scoped packet before every handoff. Packets contain the exact routed sources, content hashes, story acceptance criteria, and always-on invariants. Agents may expand beyond the packet only after recording a missing-context reason.

_hil_doc: Default ALL gates ON for first run. Per-story effect only — never mid-story.
_hil_auto_mode_note: 2026-08-17: Build-phase gates (planning/codegen/testgen/rfc) turned off per explicit user request to run the MVP queue (A-02..E-07) autonomously, per GETTING-STARTED.md's own documented mechanism -- the supervisor auto-advances on the real test-gate result and self-heals on failure rather than pausing for approval. Phase 1/2/4 gates (discovery/requirements/adr/lld/story_gen/shadow/review/release) are untouched.

telemetry._doc: Every agent run emits one record against schemas/telemetry.schema.json. This is what makes the three dashboards real instead of representative.

economics._doc: Used by the executive dashboard TCO formula. Fill with real values to make ROI numbers real — left at 0 until Tenant #1 baseline effort is measured.
